title: The widened suffix vocabulary is not mirrored in the transcript scorer's command parser

detail: Traceability: the matcher's suffix set equals the union of all 46 argument-hint documents, so spec_code passes; the transcript scorer's commandParts strips only trailing mode suffixes, so a with-modified typed command is a different name there. One P2.

reason: The sweep of every argument-hint found no suffix outside the matcher's set.

direction: a per-command vocabulary requirement in the spec
reason: No spec requirement narrows the suffix set per command; the shared set is not a spec contradiction.
The recorded limit already states the dot behavior and no new input breaks it.
